declarations.name: mass
declarations.header: def mass (μ : Measure α) (g : α → ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: weightedProbability
declarations.header: def weightedProbability (μ : Measure α) (g : α → ℝ) : Measure α

declarations.name: weightedProbability_isProbability
declarations.header:
theorem weightedProbability_isProbability (μ : Measure α) (g : α → ℝ)
    (hg : Integrable g μ) (hg0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ g x) (hm : 0 < mass μ g) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (weightedProbability μ g)

declarations.name: integral_weightedProbability
declarations.header:
theorem integral_weightedProbability (μ : Measure α) (g : α → ℝ)
    (hg : Measurable g) (hg0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ g x) (hm : 0 < mass μ g) (f : α → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂weightedProbability μ g) = (∫ x, g x * f x ∂μ) / mass μ g

declarations.name: integrable_weightedProbability
declarations.header:
theorem integrable_weightedProbability (μ : Measure α) (g : α → ℝ)
    (hg : Measurable g) (hg0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ g x) (hm : 0 < mass μ g)
    {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable (fun x => g x * f x) μ) :
    Integrable f (weightedProbability μ g)

declarations.name: negativeLogProduct
declarations.header: def negativeLogProduct (L : ι → α → ℝ) (x : α) : ℝ

declarations.name: exp_negativeLogProduct
declarations.header:
theorem exp_negativeLogProduct (L : ι → α → ℝ) {x : α} (hL : ∀ i, 0 < L i x) :
    Real.exp (negativeLogProduct L x) = 1 / ∏ i, L i x

declarations.name: weighted_probability_log_jensen
declarations.header:
theorem weighted_probability_log_jensen
    (μ : Measure α) (g : α → ℝ) (L : ι → α → ℝ) (B : ι → ℝ)
    (hgMeas : Measurable g) (hgInt : Integrable g μ)
    (hg0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ g x) (hm : 0 < mass μ g)
    (hL0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i, 0 < L i x)
    (hLog : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => g x * Real.log (L i x)) μ)
    (hRecip : Integrable (fun x => g x / ∏ i, L i x) μ)
    (hBound : ∀ i, (∫ x, g x * Real.log (L i x) ∂μ) / mass μ g ≤ B i) :
    mass μ g * Real.exp (-∑ i, B i) ≤ ∫ x, g x / ∏ i, L i x ∂μ

declarations.name: cubicCorrection
declarations.header: def cubicCorrection (T : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: cubicCorrection_le_exp
declarations.header: theorem cubicCorrection_le_exp {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) : cubicCorrection T ≤ Real.exp T

declarations.name: weighted_log_gap_cubic_lower
declarations.header:
theorem weighted_log_gap_cubic_lower
    (μ : Measure α) (g : α → ℝ) (L : ι → α → ℝ) (means gaps : ι → ℝ)
    (hgMeas : Measurable g) (hgInt : Integrable g μ)
    (hg0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ g x) (hm : 0 < mass μ g)
    (hL0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i, 0 < L i x)
    (hLog : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => g x * Real.log (L i x)) μ)
    (hRecip : Integrable (fun x => g x / ∏ i, L i x) μ)
    (hMeans : ∀ i, 0 < means i) (hGaps : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gaps i)
    (hBound : ∀ i, (∫ x, g x * Real.log (L i x) ∂μ) / mass μ g ≤
      Real.log (means i) - gaps i) :
    (mass μ g / ∏ i, means i) * cubicCorrection (∑ i, gaps i) ≤
      ∫ x, g x / ∏ i, L i x ∂μ

declarations.name: weighted_log_gap_cubic_lower_four
declarations.header:
theorem weighted_log_gap_cubic_lower_four
    (μ : Measure α) (g : α → ℝ) (L : ι → α → ℝ) (means gaps : ι → ℝ)
    (hgMeas : Measurable g) (hgInt : Integrable g μ)
    (hg0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ g x) (hm : 0 < mass μ g)
    (hL0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i, 0 < L i x)
    (hLog : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => g x * Real.log (L i x)) μ)
    (hRecip : Integrable (fun x => g x / ∏ i, L i x) μ)
    (hMeans : ∀ i, 0 < means i) (hGaps : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gaps i)
    (hBound : ∀ i, (∫ x, g x * Real.log (L i x) ∂μ) / mass μ g ≤
      Real.log (means i) - gaps i) :
    (4 * mass μ g / ∏ i, means i) * cubicCorrection (∑ i, gaps i) ≤
      ∫ x, 4 * g x / ∏ i, L i x ∂μ

declarations.name: affineScalar
declarations.header: def affineScalar {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (a : Fin d → ℝ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: continuous_affineScalar
declarations.header:
theorem continuous_affineScalar {d : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (a : Fin d → ℝ) :
    Continuous (affineScalar c a)

declarations.name: compact_affine_cell_log_jensen
declarations.header:
theorem compact_affine_cell_log_jensen {d : ℕ}
    (D : Set (Fin d → ℝ)) (hD : IsCompact D) (hDMeas : MeasurableSet D)
    (gc : ℝ) (ga : Fin d → ℝ) (Lc : ι → ℝ) (La : ι → Fin d → ℝ) (B : ι → ℝ)
    (hg0 : ∀ x ∈ D, 0 ≤ affineScalar gc ga x)
    (hL0 : ∀ x ∈ D, ∀ i, 0 < affineScalar (Lc i) (La i) x)
    (hm : 0 < ∫ x in D, affineScalar gc ga x)
    (hBound : ∀ i,
      (∫ x in D, affineScalar gc ga x * Real.log (affineScalar (Lc i) (La i) x)) /
        (∫ x in D, affineScalar gc ga x) ≤ B i) :
    (∫ x in D, affineScalar gc ga x) * Real.exp (-∑ i, B i) ≤
      ∫ x in D, affineScalar gc ga x / ∏ i, affineScalar (Lc i) (La i) x

declarations.name: partialSix
declarations.header: def partialSix (y : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: remainderSix
declarations.header: def remainderSix (y : ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: partialSix_explicit
declarations.header:
theorem partialSix_explicit (y : ℝ) :
    partialSix y = y + y ^ 2 / 2 + y ^ 3 / 3 + y ^ 4 / 4 + y ^ 5 / 5 + y ^ 6 / 6

declarations.name: hasDerivAt_partialSix
declarations.header:
theorem hasDerivAt_partialSix (y : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt partialSix (1 + y + y ^ 2 + y ^ 3 + y ^ 4 + y ^ 5) y

declarations.name: hasDerivAt_remainderSix
declarations.header:
theorem hasDerivAt_remainderSix {y : ℝ} (hy : y < 1) :
    HasDerivAt remainderSix (-y ^ 6 / (1 - y)) y

declarations.name: continuousOn_remainderSix
declarations.header:
theorem continuousOn_remainderSix {q : ℝ} (hq : q < 1) :
    ContinuousOn remainderSix (Icc (0 : ℝ) q)

declarations.name: concaveOn_remainderSix
declarations.header:
theorem concaveOn_remainderSix {q : ℝ} (hq : q < 1) :
    ConcaveOn ℝ (Icc (0 : ℝ) q) remainderSix

declarations.name: gapSix
declarations.header: def gapSix (ν : Measure α) (Y : α → ℝ) : ℝ

declarations.name: integrable_partialSix
declarations.header:
theorem integrable_partialSix (ν : Measure α) (Y : α → ℝ)
    (hPow : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 → Integrable (fun x => Y x ^ k) ν) :
    Integrable (fun x => partialSix (Y x)) ν

declarations.name: integral_partialSix
declarations.header:
theorem integral_partialSix (ν : Measure α) (Y : α → ℝ)
    (hPow : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 → Integrable (fun x => Y x ^ k) ν) :
    (∫ x, partialSix (Y x) ∂ν) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 6, (∫ x, Y x ^ (i + 1) ∂ν) / ((i : ℝ) + 1)

declarations.name: partialSix_integral_difference
declarations.header:
theorem partialSix_integral_difference (ν : Measure α) (Y : α → ℝ)
    (hPow : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 → Integrable (fun x => Y x ^ k) ν) :
    (∫ x, partialSix (Y x) ∂ν) - partialSix (∫ x, Y x ∂ν) = gapSix ν Y

declarations.name: probability_log_one_sub_bound
declarations.header:
theorem probability_log_one_sub_bound
    (ν : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (Y : α → ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : q < 1)
    (hRange : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, Y x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) q)
    (hPow : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 → Integrable (fun x => Y x ^ k) ν)
    (hLog : Integrable (fun x => Real.log (1 - Y x)) ν) :
    (∫ x, Real.log (1 - Y x) ∂ν) ≤
      Real.log (1 - ∫ x, Y x ∂ν) - gapSix ν Y

declarations.name: scaledDeviation
declarations.header: def scaledDeviation (top : ℝ) (L : α → ℝ) (x : α) : ℝ

declarations.name: scaledDeviation_range
scaledDeviation_mean
declarations.header:
theorem scaledDeviation_mean (ν : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (top : ℝ) (L : α → ℝ) (hL : Integrable L ν) :
    (∫ x, scaledDeviation top L x ∂ν) = 1 - (∫ x, L x ∂ν) / top

declarations.name: probability_factor_log_bound
declarations.header:
theorem probability_factor_log_bound
    (ν : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (top : ℝ) (hTop : 0 < top) (L : α → ℝ)
    {q : ℝ} (hq : q < 1)
    (hRange : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, scaledDeviation top L x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) q)
    (hL0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, 0 < L x) (hL : Integrable L ν)
    (hLogL : Integrable (fun x => Real.log (L x)) ν)
    (hPow : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 →
      Integrable (fun x => scaledDeviation top L x ^ k) ν) :
    (∫ x, Real.log (L x) ∂ν) ≤
      Real.log (∫ x, L x ∂ν) - gapSix ν (scaledDeviation top L)

declarations.name: probability_gapSix_nonneg
declarations.header:
theorem probability_gapSix_nonneg
    (ν : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (Y : α → ℝ)
    (hY0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, 0 ≤ Y x)
    (hPow : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 → Integrable (fun x => Y x ^ k) ν) :
    0 ≤ gapSix ν Y

declarations.name: weighted_degreeSix_log_moment_bound
declarations.header:
theorem weighted_degreeSix_log_moment_bound
    (μ : Measure α) (g L : α → ℝ) (top : ℝ) (hTop : 0 < top)
    (hgMeas : Measurable g) (hgInt : Integrable g μ)
    (hg0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ g x) (hm : 0 < mass μ g)
    (hLInt : Integrable (fun x => g x * L x) μ)
    (hLogInt : Integrable (fun x => g x * Real.log (L x)) μ)
    (hL0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 < L x) {q : ℝ} (hq : q < 1)
    (hRange : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, scaledDeviation top L x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) q)
    (hPow : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 →
      Integrable (fun x => scaledDeviation top L x ^ k) (weightedProbability μ g)) :
    (∫ x, g x * Real.log (L x) ∂μ) / mass μ g ≤
      Real.log ((∫ x, g x * L x ∂μ) / mass μ g) -
        gapSix (weightedProbability μ g) (scaledDeviation top L)

declarations.name: fixedNumerator
declarations.header: def fixedNumerator (bits : ℕ) (r : ℚ) : ℤ

declarations.name: roundDownQ
declarations.header: def roundDownQ (bits : ℕ) (r : ℚ) : ℚ

declarations.name: fixedNumerator_eq_floor
declarations.header:
theorem fixedNumerator_eq_floor (bits : ℕ) (r : ℚ) :
    fixedNumerator bits r = ⌊(r : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ bits⌋

declarations.name: roundDownQ_le
declarations.header: theorem roundDownQ_le (bits : ℕ) (r : ℚ) : (roundDownQ bits r : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ)

declarations.name: roundDownQ_nonneg
declarations.header: theorem roundDownQ_nonneg (bits : ℕ) {r : ℚ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) : 0 ≤ roundDownQ bits r

declarations.name: fixedNumerator_mono
declarations.header:
theorem fixedNumerator_mono (bits : ℕ) {r s : ℚ} (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    fixedNumerator bits r ≤ fixedNumerator bits s

declarations.name: gapEvaluator
declarations.header: def gapEvaluator (moments : ℕ → ℚ) : ℚ

declarations.name: factorFloorQ80
declarations.header: def factorFloorQ80 (moments : ℕ → ℚ) : ℤ

declarations.name: factorLowerQ80
declarations.header: def factorLowerQ80 (moments : ℕ → ℚ) : ℚ

declarations.name: gapEvaluator_cast
declarations.header:
theorem gapEvaluator_cast (ν : Measure α) (Y : α → ℝ) (moments : ℕ → ℚ)
    (hMom : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 → (moments k : ℝ) = ∫ x, Y x ^ k ∂ν) :
    (gapEvaluator moments : ℝ) = gapSix ν Y

declarations.name: factor_Q80_sound
declarations.header:
theorem factor_Q80_sound
    (ν : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (L : α → ℝ) (top : ℝ) (hTop : 0 < top)
    (moments : ℕ → ℚ) {q : ℝ} (hq : q < 1)
    (hRange : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, scaledDeviation top L x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) q)
    (hL0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, 0 < L x) (hL : Integrable L ν)
    (hLog : Integrable (fun x => Real.log (L x)) ν)
    (hPow : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 → Integrable (fun x => scaledDeviation top L x ^ k) ν)
    (hMom : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 →
      (moments k : ℝ) = ∫ x, scaledDeviation top L x ^ k ∂ν) :
    0 ≤ factorLowerQ80 moments ∧
      (∫ x, Real.log (L x) ∂ν) ≤
        Real.log (∫ x, L x ∂ν) - (factorLowerQ80 moments : ℝ)

declarations.name: totalLowerQ80
declarations.header: def totalLowerQ80 (moments : ι → ℕ → ℚ) : ℚ

declarations.name: totalLowerQ80_integer_formula
declarations.header:
theorem totalLowerQ80_integer_formula (moments : ι → ℕ → ℚ) :
    totalLowerQ80 moments = ((∑ i, factorFloorQ80 (moments i) : ℤ) : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ 80

declarations.name: cubicQ
declarations.header: def cubicQ (T : ℚ) : ℚ

declarations.name: oldEvaluator
declarations.header: def oldEvaluator (actualMass : ℚ) (means : ι → ℚ) : ℚ

declarations.name: newEvaluator
declarations.header: def newEvaluator (actualMass : ℚ) (means : ι → ℚ) (moments : ι → ℕ → ℚ) : ℚ

declarations.name: oldFloorQ96
declarations.header: def oldFloorQ96 (actualMass : ℚ) (means : ι → ℚ) : ℤ

declarations.name: newFloorQ96
declarations.header: def newFloorQ96 (actualMass : ℚ) (means : ι → ℚ) (moments : ι → ℕ → ℚ) : ℤ

declarations.name: simplexLowerQ96
declarations.header: def simplexLowerQ96 (actualMass : ℚ) (means : ι → ℚ) (moments : ι → ℕ → ℚ) : ℚ

declarations.name: cubicQ_cast
declarations.header: theorem cubicQ_cast (T : ℚ) : (cubicQ T : ℝ) = cubicCorrection (T : ℝ)

declarations.name: newEvaluator_cast
declarations.header:
theorem newEvaluator_cast (m : ℚ) (means : ι → ℚ) (moments : ι → ℕ → ℚ) :
    (newEvaluator m means moments : ℝ) =
      (4 * (m : ℝ) / ∏ i, (means i : ℝ)) *
        cubicCorrection (∑ i, (factorLowerQ80 (moments i) : ℝ))

declarations.name: old_le_newEvaluator
declarations.header:
theorem old_le_newEvaluator {m : ℚ} (hm : 0 ≤ m) (means : ι → ℚ)
    (hMeans : ∀ i, 0 < means i) (moments : ι → ℕ → ℚ)
    (hGaps : ∀ i, 0 ≤ factorLowerQ80 (moments i)) :
    oldEvaluator m means ≤ newEvaluator m means moments

declarations.name: oldFloorQ96_le_newFloorQ96
declarations.header:
theorem oldFloorQ96_le_newFloorQ96 {m : ℚ} (hm : 0 ≤ m) (means : ι → ℚ)
    (hMeans : ∀ i, 0 < means i) (moments : ι → ℕ → ℚ)
    (hGaps : ∀ i, 0 ≤ factorLowerQ80 (moments i)) :
    oldFloorQ96 m means ≤ newFloorQ96 m means moments

declarations.name: source_old_mass_dictionary
declarations.header:
theorem source_old_mass_dictionary (volume G den : ℚ) (means : ι → ℚ) :
    oldEvaluator (volume * G / (9 * den)) means =
      4 * volume * (G / (9 * den)) / ∏ i, means i

declarations.name: checkStoredQ96
declarations.header: def checkStoredQ96 (stored : ℤ) (m : ℚ) (means : ι → ℚ) (moments : ι → ℕ → ℚ) : Bool

declarations.name: storedQ96_le_computed
declarations.header:
theorem storedQ96_le_computed (stored : ℤ) (m : ℚ) (means : ι → ℚ)
    (moments : ι → ℕ → ℚ) (hStored : checkStoredQ96 stored m means moments = true) :
    (stored : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ) ^ 96 ≤ simplexLowerQ96 m means moments

declarations.name: simplex_Q96_sound
declarations.header:
theorem simplex_Q96_sound
    (μ : Measure α) (g : α → ℝ) (L : ι → α → ℝ)
    (m : ℚ) (means top : ι → ℚ) (moments : ι → ℕ → ℚ)
    (hgMeas : Measurable g) (hgInt : Integrable g μ)
    (hg0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ g x) (hm : 0 < mass μ g)
    (hMass : (m : ℝ) = mass μ g) (hMeansPos : ∀ i, 0 < means i) (hTop : ∀ i, 0 < top i)
    (hMeans : ∀ i, (means i : ℝ) = (∫ x, g x * L i x ∂μ) / mass μ g)
    (hL0 : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ i, 0 < L i x)
    (hLInt : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => g x * L i x) μ)
    (hLog : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => g x * Real.log (L i x)) μ)
    (hRecip : Integrable (fun x => g x / ∏ i, L i x) μ)
    (q : ι → ℝ) (hq : ∀ i, q i < 1)
    (hRange : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, scaledDeviation (top i : ℝ) (L i) x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (q i))
    (hPow : ∀ i, ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 →
      Integrable (fun x => scaledDeviation (top i : ℝ) (L i) x ^ k) (weightedProbability μ g))
    (hMom : ∀ i, ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ 6 →
      (moments i k : ℝ) = ∫ x, scaledDeviation (top i : ℝ) (L i) x ^ k ∂weightedProbability μ g) :
    (simplexLowerQ96 m means moments : ℝ) ≤ ∫ x, 4 * g x / ∏ i, L i x ∂μ

declarations.name: refloor_intermediate_sound
declarations.header:
theorem refloor_intermediate_sound (bits : ℕ) (r : ℚ) {I : ℝ} (h : (r : ℝ) ≤ I) :
    (roundDownQ bits r : ℝ) ≤ I
